summary: Claude Code (claude-opus-5-5, auto mode, hc t382) ran the Chough-driven approve of plan step 6 (#236, REQ-records-008) itself: chough checkpoint --close-gate on a scope gate held at plan, built from this branch's step 6 source, in a throwaway project with real SpecSync 6.2.0 and one configured SYNTHETIC human. The permission classifier did not refuse it. Chough ran specsync change approve once with --actor SYNTHETIC-human and a note quoting the relayed words, place and recording agent; SpecSync recorded the definition approval (approved, approval_valid true); the gate closed with the relay and a decision naming the step; chough next then showed no pending direct native write.
provenance: unauthenticated observation; not proof of human approval, test execution, or deployment
limitations: The human was synthetic and the project a throwaway, with no real person's decision relayed. The classifier refused the direct specsync approve as 0xLeif in this repository (OBS-dry-run-e43743fac8e3ffdcf0e1dd26), so it may judge a real human's relayed decision differently. The real check runs at plan step 14, when this repository is on 0.6.0 and a decision of Leif's is relayed through the gate.
Run from a debug build of this branch's working tree before the step 6 commit, not a release build.
